extracted.intended_audience: federal audit organizations, agency auditors, agency heads and deputy heads, audit managers, and oversight officials
extracted.subtask_short: OMB Circular A-73 federal audit guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements from OMB Circular A-73 (June 20, 1983) describing policies federal audit organizations must follow when auditing agency organizations, programs, activities, and functions, including organization/staffing, planning, coordination, followup, and use of other audit work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization and staffing
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on Organization and staffing has been changed to parallel some of the requirements contained in the Inspectors General legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For example, the Circular now requires non-statutory audit organizations to report to the head or deputy head of the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination among audit organization and other units
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific references are made to coordination between the audit organization, the designated followup official, investigative units, and other management review activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit organizations must coordinate their work with followup officials and investigative/management review functions to ensure roles and responsibilities are clear and to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adequate training of professional staff
rubrics_metrics.description: A reference to the need for adequate training of the professional staff was inserted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit organizations are expected to provide sufficient training to their auditors to meet the skills and competency required to carry out audits under the Circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain audit universe records
rubrics_metrics.description: Each audit organization is required to maintain records of its audit universe which identifies the organizations, programs, activities, and functions subject to audit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The audit universe record should comprehensively identify auditable entities/functions to support audit planning and prioritization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for determining audit priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on establishing criteria for determining audit priorities has been amended to include reference to the vulnerability assessments and internal control reviews required by Circular A-123, 'internal control systems.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Circular reordered and clarified the priority criteria; vulnerability assessments and A-123 internal control reviews must be considered when setting audit priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reliance on non-federal audits / single audit concept
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on reliance on non-federal audits was revised to reflect the responsibility of recipient organizations to arrange for audits of federally assisted programs as required by OMB Circulars A-102 (single audit concept), A-110, and the authorizing statutes and regulations for block grant programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit organizations should account for and appropriately rely on non-federal audits where recipient organizations have arranged required audits; policies should align with A-102/A-110 and applicable statutes/regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal audit responsibility for federally assisted programs
rubrics_metrics.description: The responsibility of federal audit organizations for auditing these programs was revised accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where recipient organizations are responsible for required audits, federal audit organizations must revise their roles and responsibilities in accordance with the single audit requirements and program statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation of annual audit plans
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on preparation of annual audit plans has been revised and clarified to require specific data on the programs and operations which have been selected for audit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual audit plans must include specific data on selected programs/operations and the plan must be reviewed with the head or deputy head of the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of audit plans with agency leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: A requirement that the plan be reviewed with the head or deputy head of the agency has been added.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit plans should be discussed and reviewed at senior agency leadership level to ensure alignment with agency priorities and oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination of audit work — roles of PCIE and Intergovernmental Audit Forums
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on coordination of audit work has been changed and new paragraphs added describing the respective roles in the audit process of the President's Council on Integrity and Efficiency and the National and Regional Intergovernmental Audit Forums.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit coordination should take into account the roles and guidance from PCIE and National/Regional Intergovernmental Audit Forums to promote consistency and interagency collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit followup and management action on recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: The section on audit followup was completely revised; policies for audit followup are now set forth in Circular A-50, 'Audit followup.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This section restates the importance of management action on audit recommendations and references Circular A-50 for detailed audit followup policies and procedures.
